## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 42-juan early-Qīng Chán lamp-record continuation, compiled by the Cáodòng-line monk Bié'ān Xìngtǒng 別庵性統 as a continuation of the *Wǔdēng huìyuán* ([KR6q0012](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0012)) with coverage of the Yuán, Míng, and early Qīng generations. The title — "Orthodox Succession Continuing the Lamp" — announces its claim to authoritative genealogical succession.

**Abstract**

Xìngtǒng's compilation represents the Cáodòng response to Fèiyǐn [Tōngróng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%80%9A%E5%AE%B9)'s earlier *Wǔdēng yántǒng* ([KR6q0019](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0019)), restoring the Cáodòng-line attributions that Tōngróng had re-routed to Línjì ancestors. The work is accordingly one of the principal documents in the mid-Qīng phase of the Línjì-Cáodòng lineage controversy, alongside its Línjì rival [Chāoyǒng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%B6%85%E6%B0%B8)'s *Wǔdēng quánshū* ([KR6q0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0022)) of 1697. The two works — appearing within six years of each other — represent the two lineages' competing closings of the lamp-record tradition.
